title: Ironhollow Rising Again
author: Kestrel Okafor
blurb: Noor Pemberton, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the long winter finishes falling.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
